messages.message: ### Step 2: Direct Translation Translate each source line into Estonian, guided by the Reference Translation and Step 1 analysis. Output: ONE Estonian line per source line (preserve line count and end punctuation). Rules: - Follow the meaning from Reference Translation. - For "so X that Y": keep resultative structure, do NOT convert to "because". - No internal punctuation; copy only end punctuation from source.
Kui ma nägin teda suures kõrbes, Halasta mulle karjus ma talle, Olgu sa mis tahes kas vari või tõeline mees!.

### Step 3: Word Table & Coverage Check Build a word table from Step 2 translation, mapping each source word to its target equivalent. Output: ONE Markdown table (all lines combined). Columns: [Source Word] | [Contextual Definition] | [Target Word/Phrase] | [Back-Translation] | [Status: OK/MISSING/WRONG/GRAMMAR/UNNECESSARY] Mark GRAMMAR for agreement errors (gender, number, case) or other grammatical mistakes. Mark UNNECESSARY for elements present in source but not needed in target language (e.g., articles that target language omits naturally). After the table, list any MISSING, WRONG, GRAMMAR, or UNNECESSARY items.

**Word‑to‑Word Alignment Table (Estonian translation)**
| Source Word | Contextual Definition | Target Word / Phrase | Back‑Translation (EN) | Status | |-------------|-----------------------|----------------------|------------------------|--------| | Quando | temporal conjunction “when” | Kui | when | OK | | vidi | verb “saw” (past) | nägin | I saw | OK | | costui | demonstrative pronoun “him” | teda | him | OK | | nel | preposition “in the” (spatial) | (‑) kõrbes* | in the desert (case) | UNNECESSARY* | | gran | adjective “great” | suures | great (large) | OK | | diserto | noun “desert” | kõrbes | desert | OK | | Miserere | imperative “have pity” | Halasta | have mercy | OK | | di | preposition “on / to” (object of mercy) | mulle | to me | OK | | me | pronoun “me” (object of *di*) | – | – | UNNECESSARY | | gridai | verb “cried / shouted” (past) | karjus | I shouted | WRONG (verb form; should be *karjusin*) | | a | preposition “to” (dative) | – | – | UNNECESSARY | | lui | pronoun “him” (dative) | talle | to him | OK | | qual | relative pronoun “whatever” | mis | whatever | OK | | che | relative particle (part of *qual che*) | – | – | UNNECESSARY | | tu | pronoun “you” (2nd sg) | sa | you | OK | | sii | subjunctive “be” (non‑assertive) | Olgu | be (let it be) | WRONG (written as *Olust*) | | od (1) | conjunction “or” | kas | or (introducing alternative) | OK | | ombra | noun “shade” | vari | shade | OK | | od (2) | conjunction “or” | või | or | OK | | omo | noun “man” | mees | man | OK | | certo | adjective “certain / real” | tõeline | real / genuine | OK |
\*The preposition *nel* is not expressed as a separate word in Estonian; the locative case on **kõrbes** carries the meaning “in the”. Hence it is marked **UNNECESSARY** for a one‑to‑one mapping.
---
### Items to Review
- **WRONG**: - *Olust* (should be **Olgu**) – mis‑translation of *sii*. - *karjus* (should be **karjusin**) – incorrect verb form and missing personal ending.
- **GRAMMAR**: (covered by the WRONG entries above; the verb forms are grammatically incorrect).
- **UNNECESSARY**: - *nel* (preposition is absorbed by the case ending on **kõrbes**). - *me* (object already encoded in **mulle**). - *a* (dative expressed by **talle**). - *che* (syntactic particle without lexical counterpart in Estonian).
- **MISSING**: none – every source lexical item has a corresponding target element (even if marked UNNECESSARY).

### Step 4: Correction & Final Output Fix any MISSING, WRONG, or GRAMMAR items from Step 3. Reorder within line if needed; do not add new content words. Verify that the output contains only Estonian script; no other language scripts should be mixed in. Output format (use nested bullet list, not table): - Line N: - Original: ... - Issue: ... (or "none") - Corrected: ... (or "no change") Output final Estonian text in ONE code block, line by line (no extra prose).

- **Line 64** - **Original:** Kui ma nägin teda suures kõrbes, - **Issue:** none - **Corrected:** no change
- **Line 65** - **Original:** Halasta mulle karjus ma talle, - **Issue:** verb form incorrect and word order unnatural - **Corrected:** Halasta mulle, karjusin ma talle,
- **Line 66** - **Original:** Olgu sa mis tahes kas vari või tõeline mees! . - **Issue:** punctuation errors (missing comma, stray exclamation and space before period) - **Corrected:** Olgu sa mis tahes, kas vari või tõeline mees.
